title: Marathi Technology Words: Phone, Internet, Apps & Devices
description: 15 Marathi technology words — मोबाईल, संगणक, इंटरनेट, व्हायफाय, ऐप, व्हाट्सअॅप — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, examples from Unit 12.
intro: Fifteen Marathi technology words from Unit 12 — the everyday digital vocabulary you need for phones, internet, apps and devices. Each entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence from the curriculum.

Most tech words are English loans written in Devanagari — the Marathi part is the spelling conventions (मोबाईल, व्हायफाय, व्हाट्सअॅप, बॅटरी) and the verb frames (फोन करा, मेसेज पाठवा, चार्ज करा, डाउनलोड करा). Learn the nouns once, add the verbs, and you have the full digital toolkit.
tip: मोबाईल, इंटरनेट, चार्ज, ऐप, बॅटरी — these are the same words, just Devanagari. The Marathi magic is in the verbs: फोन करा, मेसेज पाठवा, चार्ज करा, डाउनलोड करा।

sections.heading: Devices & connections — the nouns you already know
paragraphs: मोबाईल (mobile), संगणक (computer), इंटरनेट (internet), व्हायफाय (WiFi), कॅमरा (camera), बॅटरी (battery), चार्जर (charger), स्क्रीन (screen), सिम कार्ड (SIM card) — these are English loans in Devanagari. The spelling flags: मोबाईल (ि + ल), व्हायफाय (ॅ), व्हाट्सअॅप (ॅ), बॅटरी (ॅ), कॅमरा (ॅ).

sections.heading: Actions — the Marathi verb frames
paragraphs: फोन करा (call), मेसेज पाठवा (send message), चार्ज करा (charge), डाउनलोड करा (download), इंस्टॉल करा (install), डिलीट करा (delete), सर्च करा (search), रीस्टार्ट करा (restart), कनेक्ट करा (connect), लॉगिन करा (login). Pattern: noun + करा. The noun is the loanword; करा does the work.

mistakes.why: Marathi writes the English loan as मोबाईल; the Hindi spelling मोबाइल uses the wrong vowel sign.

mistakes.wrong: Saying इंटरनेट काम करत आहे for "internet is working"
mistakes.why: चालू = on/working; बंद = off. चालू/बंद is the standard on/off pair.
Marathi uses ॅ (short e) for the English 'a' in WhatsApp; व्हाट्सएप uses Hindi vowel.

mcq.question: Call me in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मला फोन करा — to me, call (dative + verb).

mcq.question: My battery is low in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: माझी बॅटरी कमी आहे — battery is feminine, so माझी/कमी.

faq.question: How do you say mobile in Marathi?
faq.answer: मोबाईल — with ि and ल, not मोबाइल. The candrabindu is not used here; just the spelling convention.

faq.question: What is WhatsApp in Marathi?
faq.answer: व्हाट्सअॅप — with ॅ (short e) for the English 'a' sound.

title: Marathi Bird Names: 12 Birds from Sparrow to Peacock
description: 12 Marathi bird names — चिमणी, मोर, कोयल, पोपट, कोबळ, गरुड — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, examples and cultural notes.
intro: Twelve Marathi bird names from the Bol Marathi curriculum — from the everyday चिमणी (sparrow) and कोबळ (pigeon) to the majestic मोर (peacock) and गरुड (eagle). Each entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.
Several Hindi bird names shift systematically in Marathi: कबूतर → कोबळ, तोता → पोपट, उल्लू → उड्डाण, कौवा → काक. The table below maps each shift so you learn the pattern once.
tip: कोबळ, पोपट, काक, शकुन — these four shifts cover the most common birds. Learn the pattern once: retroflex + vowel shift.

sections.heading: Everyday birds you will see
paragraphs: चिमणी (sparrow), कोबळ (pigeon), काक (crow) — these three are everywhere in Maharashtra. चिमणी छोटी आहे (the sparrow is small), कोबळ खिडकीवर बसले (pigeon sat on the window), काक कावतो (crow caws) — the curriculum sentences put them in daily life.

sections.heading: Cultural & iconic birds
paragraphs: मोर (peacock) — India's national bird, नाचतो आहे in monsoon. कोयल (koel) — the spring singer, बसंतऋतूचे प्रतीक. गरुड (eagle) — mythological vehicle of Vishnu. शकुन (kite/hawk) — high flier. Each carries cultural weight beyond vocabulary.

sections.heading: The systematic shifts
paragraphs: कबूतर → कोबळ, तोता → पोपट, उल्लू → उड्डाण, कौवा → काक, बगुला → बगळा. The pattern: Hindi retroflex + vowel shifts to Marathi ळ or ण or shortened form. Learn these five; the rest are identical (मोर, हंस, कोयल, गरुड, पक्षी).

mistakes.why: Systematic shift: Hindi कबूतर → Marathi कोबळ. The retroflex + vowel change is regular.
तोता → पोपट follows the same retroflex shift pattern.
पक्षी is the category word. For specific birds, use कोबळ, पोपट, मोर, etc.

mcq.question: How do you say "peacock" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: मोर (mor) — national bird, identical to Hindi.

mcq.question: What is पोपट?
mcq.explanation: पोपट (popaṭ) = parrot; Hindi तोता shifts to पोपट.

faq.question: How many bird words are on this page?
faq.answer: 12 — from everyday birds (sparrow, pigeon, crow) to cultural icons (peacock, koel, eagle), each with Hindi meaning, pronunciation and a sentence.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for parrot?
faq.answer: पोपट (popaṭ) — Hindi तोता shifts to पोपट in Marathi.

title: Marathi Shapes & Geometry: Circle, Square, Triangle & More
description: 12 Marathi shape words — गोल, चौकोन, त्रिकोण, आयत, वर्तुळ, अष्टकोण — with Hindi meanings, pronunciation, examples and geometry terms.
intro: Twelve Marathi shape and geometry words — from the basic गोल (circle) and चौकोन (square) to polygons like त्रिकोण (triangle), षट्कोण (hexagon), अष्टकोण (octagon), plus the formal terms वर्तुळ (circle) and कोन (angle). Each entry has Hindi and English meanings, pronunciation and a real example sentence.

Several Hindi shape words shift in Marathi: चौकोर → चौकोन, वृत्त → वर्तुळ, कोण → कोन. The Sanskrit-rooted terms (त्रिकोण, अष्टकोण, षट्कोण) are identical. The table below maps each so you learn the shifts and the shared terms together.
tip: त्रिकोण, षट्कोण, अष्टकोण — the -कोण (angle) suffix builds polygon names: त्रि(3)+कोण, षट्(6)+कोण, अष्ट(8)+कोण. Learn the numbers; the shapes follow.

sections.heading: Basic shapes — everyday vocabulary
paragraphs: गोल (circle/round), चौकोन (square), त्रिकोण (triangle), आयत (rectangle), अंडाकृती (oval), अर्धवर्तुळ (semicircle). These are the shapes you use daily — चेंडू गोल आहे (ball is round), मेज चौकोन आहे (table is square), अंडी अंडाकृती आहे (egg is oval).

sections.heading: Formal geometry terms
paragraphs: वर्तुळ (circle — formal), कोन (angle/corner), त्रिभुज (triangle — alt), षट्कोण (hexagon), अष्टकोण (octagon). The -कोण suffix means angle/corner: त्रि(3)+कोण, षट्(6)+कोण, अष्ट(8)+कोण. Hindi shares these Sanskrit forms identically.

sections.heading: The systematic shifts
paragraphs: चौकोर → चौकोन (ण shift), वृत्त → वर्तुळ (ळ shift), कोण → कोन (shortening). These three shifts cover the core geometry vocabulary differences from Hindi.

mistakes.why: Hindi चौकोर → Marathi चौकोन. The ण shift is systematic in geometry words.
वृत्त → वर्तुळ (ळ shift). गोल is the everyday word; वर्तुळ is the geometry term.
आकार is the category word. गोल is one specific shape.

mcq.question: How do you say "triangle" in Marathi?
mcq.explanation: त्रिकोण (trikon) — tri(3) + कोण(angle). Identical to Hindi.

mcq.question: What is वर्तुळ?
mcq.explanation: वर्तुळ (vartul) — formal geometry term for circle; everyday word is गोल.

faq.question: How many shape words are on this page?
faq.answer: 12 — basic shapes (circle, square, triangle, rectangle, oval) plus formal geometry terms (circle, angle, hexagon, octagon), each with Hindi meaning and sentence.

faq.question: What is the Marathi word for circle?
faq.answer: गोल (gol) for everyday use; वर्तुळ (vartul) for formal geometry. The Hindi वृत्त shifts to वर्तुळ in Marathi.
